notes: Authoritative manufacturer spec sheet used (aja.com/products/kumo-3232/spec-sheet.pdf). This is the original 3G-SDI KUMO 3232 (32x32), distinct from the newer "KUMO 3232-12G" variant which uses 12G-SDI and different connectors — do not confuse the two. Grade sdi-3g assigned to the 32 SDI inputs/outputs since the spec sheet states 3G-SDI I/O supporting up to 3 Gbps (270Mbps/1.5Gbps/3Gbps, auto-select). The 2x BNC Reference Input (loop-through, blackburst/tri-level sync) is a sync signal, not a graded video payload port, so no grade was set. Power: the unit has no internal AC inlet; it requires an external power supply. The enclosure's own DC input connector is a 4-pin Molex (dual, redundant, 10-14VDC, 43.2W max) — not an exact match to any connector in the allowed list, so it was mapped to the closest available option, dc-barrel, as a caveat-flagged approximation. The included external AC-to-DC adapter brick (100-240VAC, 60W) is a separate accessory and was not modeled as a device port. USB port is Mini-USB (device/config port, not USB host), mapped to usb-b as the closest match since usb-micro is technically closer but AJA's own diagram just says "Mini-USB" — flagged in notes. No grade set on Ethernet since the spec only states 10/100/1000 support without specifying which speed is actually negotiated in typical use; grade eth-1g reflects the top supported speed per spec.

ports.name: Inputs 1-32
ports.note: 32x BNC 3G/HD/SD-SDI inputs, SMPTE-259/292/424, one port group of 32 identical connectors

ports.name: Outputs 1-32
ports.note: 32x BNC 3G/HD/SD-SDI outputs, SMPTE-259/292/424, noninverting, one port group of 32 identical connectors

ports.name: Ref
ports.note: External reference input, 2x BNC looping (nonterminating), Blackburst or tri-level sync — not a graded video payload port

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: 10/100/1000 Ethernet, embedded web server, KUMO control panel support, basic Grass Valley Native Protocol

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Mini-USB port for IP configuration via AJA eMini-Setup; closest available connector id to the device's actual Mini-USB port

ports.name: RS-422
ports.note: 9-pin D-connector (DB-9 Female), basic Grass Valley Native Protocol support

ports.name: PS 1 / PS 2 (DC In)
ports.note: Dual redundant DC power inputs, actual connector is 4-pin Molex, 10-14VDC regulated, 18W typical / 43.2W max each — 4-pin Molex is not in the allowed connector list, dc-barrel used as closest approximation; powered by an included external 100-240VAC universal AC adapter brick (accessory, not modeled as a device port)
